Steps: unique id [a-z0-9_-], title <=80, kind inspect|edit|analyze|verify, checkIndexes are zero-based indexes into checks. First step must be inspect, last verify. Middle steps must be edit for edit intent, analyze for analyze intent. Every edit step has relevant checkIndexes. Cover every check in an edit step; put checks for recalculated dependent values in the edit step that changes its input. Do not split dependent value/formula verification into a second writing step. Each edit step runs and is verified BEFORE the next; combine changes that must execute together. Clarify/unsupported use steps:[]. Check address: an A1 cell or range inside the selection, such as A2 or A2:C2, written WITHOUT a sheet name. Check fields: value,formula,bold,italic,fillColor,numberFormat,fontName,fontSize,fontColor,horizontalAlignment,verticalAlignment,wrapText. Do not create checks for validation, merge, lock, borders, sizes or displayed text: the host compares those properties itself after every write. A value check may include valueType:text|number|percent|date|boolean; use ISO yyyy-mm-dd for typed dates and explicit percent strings such as 10% (numeric percent means an already normalized fraction). The host converts typed expectations, including the workbook date system. Operators: equals,not_empty,no_error. expected is a scalar or rectangular matrix; omit for not_empty/no_error. Maximum 30 checks. Derive exact expectations only from the user's request and observed data, never invent business decisions. For calculations prefer intended formulas and no_error; Excel computes values. Edit intent REQUIRES concrete checks. Missing essential input means clarify. Capabilities: selected-range values, formulas, bold,italic,fillColor,numberFormat,fontName,fontSize,fontColor,horizontalAlignment,verticalAlignment,wrapText, set_typed_values, and copying these supported format fields from an observed reference cell in the selection. Match value meaning (code/text, numeric amounts, percentages, date, booleans), business units and existing template formats together; 0 and false are real values. Preserve leading zeros in codes as text. Never guess an unknown currency, unit, date interpretation or missing business input. Ask only for missing facts. Preserve existing formula cells, labels and geometry.
